Every operator the fabric's own differential calculus can build (inner fluctuation `A=Σaᵢ[D_K,bᵢ]`, its real image `ε'JAJ⁻¹`, the twisted-inner module `Ω¹_σ` for any `σ∈Aut(A_K)`, the SU(3)-equivariant Casimir deformation) acts as a SCALAR on every multiplicity factor `ℂ^{m(p,q)}` and therefore cannot lift the degeneracy. The fix MUST be an EXTERNAL non-left-invariant fibre datum that breaks Wall 2 while preserving Wall 1.

- **V.3** (`S98-W3-1-YUKAWA-EPS-LX-BETWEEN-GEN`): derive the 3-generation charged-lepton Yukawa hierarchy from the external non-LI `ε_LX` BETWEEN-GENERATION channel — a 3×3 flavour object with non-degenerate singular values inserted into the ℂ³ multiplicity. Built on `S97-BARYOGEN-EXT-SOURCE` (φ_88-Cartan δA) as the structural template: same two walls, same external-datum escape, same non-removability check `P_nLI=ε²>0`.
- **V.4** (`S98-W3-1-DIAG`): INFO-class companion to V.3 — quantify the maximal `J_K`-real Hermitian splitting available inside the `J`-FIXED (`p=q`) multiplets `(1,1)` (dim 8) and `(2,2)` (dim 27), propagated through `a₄^{Mellin}`, reported as `(within_channel_max_shift, measured, ratio)` per inter-generation ratio.     Step 3: Substitute ε_LX into the a₄ moment. Because the BARE D_K is multiplicity-scalar

               degenerate multiplicity-scalar value) TOWARD the observed hierarchy. The
               degeneracy R_cross=1.01970 is the s→0 limit; a finite non-degenerate spread
               is REQUIRED to reach (1:206.8:3477).

Wave 4 (BF-spine covariance + κ-determinacy, owner `mack-cosmic-bridge`) does NOT consume Wave 3 outputs — the matter-sector and observational-BF axes are independent. No cross-wave ordering from W3 to W4.

|:------------|:------------|:----------------|
| PASS | PASS | Matter-sector frontier pair (#7,#9) CLOSED at zero free generation/CP parameters; §VII.BL E1 advances toward a confirmed instance (one step toward K=3). CF: route E1 Stage-2 two-agent cross-axis verify (NCG-axiomatic + KK/geometric) per `joint-theorem-promotion.md`. |

| INFO | any | #7 NON-PROMOTION-BY-HELD-NUMBER on §VII.BL (channel exists, hierarchy magnitude HELD) — CF: refine the a₄^{Mellin} moment / ε_LX band, OR test the SU(3)_gen-enlargement route (with its order-one cost). |
